designationHistory.name: Blackbeard Island Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: An executive order set Blackbeard Island aside for use as a bird refuge and an experiment station for acclimatizing foreign game birds.
designationHistory.note: Sources conflict. The FWS plan cites Executive Order 4512 of September 20, 1926. The New Georgia Encyclopedia says Woodrow Wilson made the island a wildlife preserve by executive order in 1914 and that it became a refuge in 1924. The island had been a Navy timber reserve since 1800. Check the 1914 and 1924-26 orders in the National Archives before publishing.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Interim Inventory and Monitoring Plan for Blackbeard Island NWR, 2022 (ServCat 143743)
